institutional.originalHtml:
About SNJB

The Jain Gurukul campus has various faculties, out of which the SNJB's Late Sau Kantabai Bhavarlalji Jain College of Engineering, which is approved by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi and Government of Maharashtra and is affiliated to the University of Pune, was established in the year 2004 with four branches viz. Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications Engineering, and Civil Engineering.

In the year 2010 saw the assimilation of MBA under the SNJB's Late Sau Kantabai Bhavarlalji Jain College of Engineering. Similarly, the year 2020 viewed the establishment of a new branch of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.

Know More →

Our Vision

Transform young aspirant learners towards creativity and professionalism for societal growth through quality technical education.

Our Mission

  • To transfer the suitable technology, particularly for rural development.
  • To enhance diverse career opportunities among students for building nation.
  • To acquire the environment of learning to bridge the gap between industry and academics.
  • To share values, ideas, beliefs by encouraging faculties and students for welfare of society.

testimonials.quote: SNJB College has played a significant role in shaping my personality. During my time there, I developed strong leadership, time management, and teamwork skills, and was able to elevate them to a whole new level. One of the most memorable aspects of my college life was my active participation in NCC and Sports. The lessons and experiences gained through these activities continue to guide me in my professional life, helping me manage my daily responsibilities with confidence and discipline. The emphasis placed on co-curricular and extra-curricular activities, alongside academics, was truly exceptional and made my college experience both enriching and enjoyable. The professors are the true strength of the institution. Their constant support, approachable nature, and dedication to teaching make them not just educators, but lifelong pillars of learning. The knowledge and values they impart are treasures that stay with you forever.

About SNJB

The Jain Gurukul campus has various faculties, out of which the SNJB's Late Sau Kantabai Bhavarlalji Jain College of Engineering, which is approved by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi and Government of Maharashtra and is affiliated to the University of Pune, was established in the year 2004 with four branches viz. Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications Engineering, and Civil Engineering.

In the year 2010 saw the assimilation of MBA under the SNJB's Late Sau Kantabai Bhavarlalji Jain College of Engineering. Similarly, the year 2020 viewed the establishment of a new branch of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.

Know More →

Our Vision

Transform young aspirant learners towards creativity and professionalism for societal growth through quality technical education.

Our Mission

  • To transfer the suitable technology, particularly for rural development.
  • To enhance diverse career opportunities among students for building nation.
  • To acquire the environment of learning to bridge the gap between industry and academics.
  • To share values, ideas, beliefs by encouraging faculties and students for welfare of society.
